name: jarviscopilot-code-assist
description: JarvisCopilot as Claude's cross-project coding memory + session handoff. Registers each project; stores short durable coding facts and session handoffs (shared with the JarvisCopilot TUI); token-cheap progressive recall (search -> compact rows -> fetch full bodies by id); a small session-start digest; and query_memory / ask / run_skill.
